testsuite.name: tools/loop/gate.sh — the run's aggregate LOOP-GATE line
testsuite.system-out: Transcription of the one gate run's own summary line, 2026-10-27: `LOOP-GATE: tests=767 failures=0 errors=1 (...) — failing: ./gradlew test -PforceTests -PjvmTestsOnly --no-build-cache`. gate.sh sums the per-suite summary lines and writes no aggregate tally of its own, so this file carries the sum beside the per-suite XMLs under gate-tallies/, where it is checkable: tools/loop-selftest.sh 256 + bash tools/loop-mutations.sh --check 198 + tools/loop-mutations-selftest.sh 34 + tools/check-portability-selftest.sh 29 + tools/check-openspec-hygiene-selftest.sh 6 + tools/gen-feature-list-selftest.sh 119 + tools/issue-tooling-selftest.sh 125 = 767, and the build step contributes 0 cases to the engine's count (Gradle prints no `all N cases passed` line) while contributing the run's single error. The build's own failing class and its attribution are in gate.md.
